section_summary: This section contains an English translation of chapters from the postwar Japanese secondary school textbook Democracy (Minshushugi). It covers economic democracy, analyzing free competition, monopolies, capitalism, socialism, state economic controls, and agricultural and consumer cooperatives in postwar Japan. It further addresses the role and rights of labor unions under new labor legislation and collective bargaining, before contrasting democratic governance and majority rule with totalitarian dictatorships and wartime Japanese militarism.

subfiles.about: English translation of chapters from a Japanese secondary school textbook explaining economic democracy, labor unions, and the contrast between democracy and dictatorship.
subfiles.summary: This text examines the principles of economic democracy, evaluating free competition, monopolies, capitalism, and socialism while advocating for democratic economic controls and agricultural and consumer cooperatives to stabilize postwar Japanese livelihoods. It details the necessity, democratic functions, and legal frameworks of labor unions, emphasizing collective bargaining, peaceful dispute resolution, and union autonomy. Finally, it contrasts democratic governance rooted in majority rule, individual dignity, and freedom of speech with totalitarian dictatorships, repudiating wartime Japanese militarism and fascism.
subfiles.title: Democracy
